calibration.example: Legible repair intake with clear labels, a familiar layout, and misplaced focus after an invalid number

primary_action.input: Tab three times, ArrowRight, Tab twice, Enter
primary_action.expected: Select Harriman and show its etched detail
primary_action.observed: Harriman and Etched detail became selected; the photograph changed to a gray crosshatched surface. Focus remained visible on Etched detail.

A-1440.edge_observation: Shift+Tab and Enter returned to Full specimen and a different magenta and green false-color photograph. About the collection moved focus to Read the surface without leaving the exhibit.
A-1440.fact_check: Harriman, USNM 6071, the selected controls, and the visible broad silver-gray bands agree with the detail caption. The in-page source link is View the Harriman catalog record, targeting https://naturalhistory.si.edu/object/nmnhmineralsciences_1021031. The record and independent photograph provenance were not opened or verified.
A-1440.strength: The restrained serif title and large photograph create a clear exhibit hierarchy; title and controls fit.
A-1440.weakness: The left column has substantial empty space above the title, while the caption and controls are comparatively compressed.
A-1440.repair: Bring the introduction slightly higher or give the caption more breathing room while retaining the photograph as the focal point.

primary_action.input: Tab three times, ArrowRight, Tab twice, Enter
primary_action.expected: Select Harriman and show its etched detail
primary_action.observed: The selected radio, detail button, caption, and photograph updated; the focused button was clearly outlined.

A-390.edge_observation: Full specimen restored the different false-color image; About the collection moved focus to the in-page section.
A-390.fact_check: The visible gray intersecting bands match the detail caption, Harriman selection, and displayed USNM 6071. The Harriman catalog link targets https://naturalhistory.si.edu/object/nmnhmineralsciences_1021031; its external contents and image provenance remain unverified.
A-390.strength: The stacked composition keeps the title, selector, image, caption, and both controls legible and within the viewport width.
A-390.weakness: The framed image is relatively small on mobile, limiting inspection of the fine etched texture.
A-390.repair: Use more of the available card width for the photograph or offer an accessible larger view.

primary_action.input: Tab three times, ArrowRight, Tab twice, Enter
primary_action.expected: Select Harriman and show its etched detail

B-1440.edge_observation: Full specimen selected and began revealing the different false-color image; the recovery capture caught it partially revealed. About the collection moved focus to the in-page section.
B-1440.fact_check: The settled detail shows intersecting silver-gray bands consistent with the Harriman caption, USNM 6071, and selected controls. The Harriman catalog link targets https://naturalhistory.si.edu/object/nmnhmineralsciences_1021031; the external record and photograph provenance were not independently verified.
B-1440.strength: The bold title, navy field, and clear selected states create a strong hierarchy; title and controls fit.
B-1440.weakness: The image reveal temporarily leaves most of the photograph area blank after the caption and selection have already changed.
B-1440.repair: Show the complete image immediately or use a brief transition that keeps the full photograph legible, including under reduced motion.

primary_action.observed: The controls and caption updated; the immediate capture showed a narrow image strip, and a subsequent capture showed the full etched detail.

B-390.edge_observation: Full specimen selected and the different false-color photo began returning; the recovery capture caught a partial reveal. About the collection moved focus to the in-page section.
B-390.fact_check: The settled photograph's silver-gray crossing bands agree visually with the detail caption, Harriman, USNM 6071, and selected controls. The Harriman catalog link targets https://naturalhistory.si.edu/object/nmnhmineralsciences_1021031; the external record and photograph provenance were not independently verified.
B-390.strength: The compact stack, strong type, and distinct focus outline make the task easy to follow; title and controls fit.
B-390.weakness: The reveal temporarily obscures most of an already small specimen image.
B-390.repair: Keep the image fully visible during state changes and consider a larger accessible view for examining the texture.

preference.reason: Both complete the keyboard task and present matching captions and controls. A's quieter typography better supports the specimen, and its observed image changes presented the complete material without B's temporary narrow-strip reveal.
